artifact_storage: All model/scaler/feature-cache artifacts in a new /tmp/ecuread-h10-1-* directory; metadata/hashes/results only in study output
context_policy: Approved-v2 conservative mappings only; fine/macro separate, no majority voting. Context labels are strata, not fault truth. Missing contexts report unsupported, never zero burden.
decision_policy: Exploratory context_experiment_justified only if a preregistered macro stationary or warming flag contrast has >=3 common-support groups, positive mean after every single-group deletion, and retains positive direction in both short-capture and discrepancy sensitivities. Otherwise insufficient_evidence; absence of evidence is not baseline adequacy. Uncertainty and conditioning support must be disclosed; no promotion/calibration in H10.1.
preprocessing: Existing per-window feature extraction unchanged. Fit default RobustScaler on all training windows only, in sorted session/window order. No balancing, resampling, global normalization, imputation beyond existing extractor, or held-out preprocessing fit.
primary_population: All 18 captures and all 9989 ML-eligible windows, including short, ambiguous, unknown and discrepant observations
reproducibility: Repeat all 18 fits from the pinned feature cache, compare model/scaler SHA, offsets and every prediction. Validate training-only scaler quantiles and offset for every fold; poison held-out features in the repeat to test fitting invariance.

sensitivity.discrepancies: Aggregation-only view masking 001 windows 0-5, the six windows intersecting the 19 retained speed/label discrepancies. No annotation mutation or boundary adjudication.
sensitivity.extremely_short: Aggregation-only view excluding captures with fewer than existing min_session_windows_for_status=10; primary and training unchanged

statistics.dominance: Report sign counts and leave-one/two-capture-out effect ranges; no detector refitting to select contrasts.
statistics.interval: Descriptive 2.5/97.5 capture-bootstrap percentiles; paired context differences on common-support captures, no interval with fewer than 3 groups. No p-values or confirmatory significance claim; overlapping windows/fold training sets are dependent.
statistics.summaries: Equal-capture first; duration-weighted capture summary second; pooled windows secondary. Within-context weights use eligible window-time union. Report consecutive flagged-window runs and union-time burden; non-stratum windows break stratum runs.
statistics.support: Per-fold context support: >=3 training capture groups, >=1 held-out window; report training/test window counts, group counts and time. This research gate does not delete states or alter production thresholds.

study_type: EXPLORATORY; prior corpus-wide model selection exposure, not independent confirmatory validation
threshold: Existing contamination=0.03 learns offset from training windows; held-out prediction uses unchanged decision_function < 0. No cutoff or hyperparameter search.
training_truth: Unlabeled captures, not independently confirmed healthy data; long captures have greater training-window weight as in original baseline.
